ui.game.title: Arken: Ashen Wings
ui.game.subtitle: A Wandering Mercenary's Epic
ui.ftue.deploy_drag.title: Deploy Leon
ui.ftue.deploy_drag.body: Drag Leon from the bench onto the glowing hex.
ui.ftue.deploy_start.title: Start the battle
ui.ftue.deploy_start.body: Tap Start when you're ready. The fight plays out automatically.
ui.ftue.battle_hud.title: Health and mana
ui.ftue.battle_hud.body: Green is health, blue is mana. A full mana bar triggers the skill.
ui.ftue.result_reward.title: First rewards
ui.ftue.result_reward.body: Victory earns gold and EXP. First clears add Dragon Gems.
ui.ftue.speed_intro.title: Battle speed
ui.ftue.speed_intro.body: Speed the battle up to 2x. Battles you've already cleared can be skipped.
ui.ftue.hero_acquired.title: A new companion
ui.ftue.hero_acquired.body: {name} has joined you. Check their stats and gear in Hero Details.
ui.ftue.hero_detail.title: Equipment tab
ui.ftue.hero_detail.body: Equip items here. Each hero has three slots.
ui.ftue.lobby_coach_worldmap.title: World map
ui.ftue.lobby_coach_worldmap.body: Story and regional battles start from the World Map.
ui.ftue.lobby_coach_heroes.title: Heroes
ui.ftue.lobby_coach_heroes.body: Manage your heroes' stars, gear and affinity.
ui.ftue.lobby_coach_shop.title: Shop (locked)
ui.ftue.lobby_coach_shop.body: The forge and shop open once you join the guild.
ui.ftue.deploy_second.title: A second unit
ui.ftue.deploy_second.body: This battle needs at least two units. Deploy Brandon too.
ui.ftue.trait_intro.title: Traits
ui.ftue.trait_intro.body: Matching origins or classes activate traits. Two Warriors unlock the first tier.
ui.ftue.guild_join.title: Joined the guild
ui.ftue.guild_join.body: You've joined the Grey Wolf Company. The shop and forge are open, and materials are waiting in your mail.
ui.ftue.craft_first.title: Your first craft
ui.ftue.craft_first.body: Combine two components into a completed item. Check the preview, then craft.
ui.ftue.equip_first.title: Equip it
ui.ftue.equip_first.body: Drag the finished item onto Leon to equip it.
ui.ftue.encounter_intro.title: Encounters
ui.ftue.encounter_intro.body: Win a battle marked with a hero portrait for a chance to recruit them. Odds and affinity are always shown.
ui.ftue.affinity_intro.title: Affinity
ui.ftue.affinity_intro.body: Failed recruits still raise affinity. At 100, the next win guarantees them.
ui.ftue.stamina_intro.title: Stamina
ui.ftue.stamina_intro.body: Each hero has stamina that regenerates 1 point every 6 minutes. You can get an alert when it's full.
ui.ftue.daily_intro.title: Daily commissions
ui.ftue.daily_intro.body: Complete three commissions each day for extra rewards. They reset at 05:00.
ui.ftue.star_up_intro.title: Star up
ui.ftue.star_up_intro.body: Duplicate heroes become shards. Use shards and materials to raise heroes to ★2 and ★3.
ui.ftue.quest_intro.title: Hero chronicles
ui.ftue.quest_intro.body: Tier 4 and 5 heroes can be guaranteed through three-step chronicle quests.
ui.ftue.hard_intro.title: Hard difficulty
ui.ftue.hard_intro.body: Battles cleared on Normal unlock Hard: rewards ×1.7, hero drops ×1.5.

origin.astel.name: Astel
origin.astel.desc: The central knight kingdom. Three princes wage civil war after the king's sudden death.
origin.astel.synergy: All allies gain Armor. Astel heroes start combat with a shield.
origin.valheim.name: Valheim
origin.valheim.desc: The northern ice kingdom; a clan federation whose king is chosen by duel.
origin.valheim.synergy: Below 50% HP, Valheim heroes gain Attack Speed and Omnivamp (berserk).
origin.sairam.name: Sairam
origin.sairam.desc: The eastern empire, ruled jointly by emperor and shogun, served by samurai, ninja and onmyoji.
origin.sairam.synergy: Sairam heroes gain Crit Chance and Crit Damage.
origin.karna.name: Karna
origin.karna.desc: The southern desert sultanate of merchant guilds, assassins and djinn-binders.
origin.karna.synergy: For 7s after combat starts, Karna heroes take reduced damage and begin with bonus mana.
origin.lies.name: Lies
origin.lies.desc: The western maritime league where pirates, merchants and merfolk coexist.
origin.lies.synergy: Lies heroes gain mana on attack; victories grant bonus gold.
origin.elowen.name: Elowen
origin.elowen.desc: The elven forest kingdom that reveres the World Tree and the spirits.
origin.elowen.synergy: Elowen heroes regenerate HP every second and gain Range.
origin.grandur.name: Grandur
origin.grandur.desc: The dwarven kingdom beneath the mountains: forges, runes and early steam engines.
origin.grandur.synergy: Grandur heroes' item stats are amplified; all allies gain Armor and Magic Resist.
origin.neos.name: Neos
origin.neos.desc: A hidden hi-tech civilization under a dome in the grey wasteland; survivors of the ancient world.
origin.neos.synergy: Neos heroes start overcharged with bonus Attack Speed; their kills trigger energy explosions.
origin.nox.name: Nox
origin.nox.desc: The fog-locked necromancer kingdom ruled by liches and vampires.
origin.nox.synergy: Nox heroes gain Omnivamp; when they die a wraith rises (limited times per battle).
origin.celestia.name: Celestia
origin.celestia.desc: The high-magic academy on floating sky islands, guardians of the World Spire.
origin.celestia.synergy: Celestia heroes gain Ability Power; casting grants mana to all allies.
origin.dragonkin.name: Dragonkin
origin.dragonkin.desc: Dragons in human form, split between the Bluescale (coexistence) and the Ashwing (destruction).
origin.dragonkin.synergy: Dragonkin heroes gain max HP and skill damage.
origin.torga.name: Torga
origin.torga.desc: The tribal federation of orcs, beastfolk, giants and goblins on the steppes and mountains.
origin.torga.synergy: Torga heroes gain stacking Attack Damage whenever they take damage or score a kill.
origin.lumen.name: Lumen
origin.lumen.desc: The theocracy of paladins, inquisitors and angel-summoners.
origin.lumen.synergy: When a Lumen hero would die, they become briefly invulnerable and heal (limited times per team per battle).
origin.freelancer.name: Freelancer
origin.freelancer.desc: Mercenaries of the Bromel guild — stateless wanderers.
origin.freelancer.synergy: Freelancer heroes gain a base Attack/Ability Power bonus plus more for every other origin on the team.
class.knight.name: Knight
class.knight.desc: Frontline tank with high Armor, taunts and shields.
class.knight.synergy: Allies in the front two columns take reduced damage.
class.warrior.name: Warrior
class.warrior.desc: Melee bruiser with high HP and close-range area damage.
class.assassin.name: Assassin
class.assassin.desc: Leaps to the enemy backline; high critical strikes.
class.assassin.synergy: Assassins gain Crit Chance and Crit Damage.
class.ranger.name: Ranger
class.ranger.desc: Ranged physical damage dealer with high Attack Speed.
class.mage.name: Mage
class.mage.desc: Ranged spell damage dealer with powerful abilities.
class.mage.synergy: Mages gain Ability Power and reduced mana cost.
class.priest.name: Priest
class.priest.synergy: Priests heal more; all allies gain Omnivamp.
class.guardian.name: Guardian
class.guardian.desc: Shield-support tank who protects adjacent allies.
class.guardian.synergy: Guardians and adjacent allies start with a shield.
class.duelist.name: Duelist
class.duelist.desc: Melee attack-speed fighter who gets faster with every hit.
class.duelist.synergy: Duelists gain stacking Attack Speed on each attack.
class.summoner.name: Summoner
class.summoner.synergy: Summons gain HP and Attack Damage.
class.artillerist.name: Artillerist
class.artillerist.desc: Very long-range physical/explosive damage with slow attacks.
class.artillerist.synergy: Artillerists gain Range and deal bonus damage on every third attack.
class.shaman.name: Shaman
class.shaman.desc: Specialist in debuffs and crowd control.
class.shaman.synergy: Enemies hit by shaman skills lose Armor and Magic Resist.
class.bard.name: Bard
class.bard.synergy: Bard buffs affect the whole team; allies start with bonus mana.
class.dragoon.name: Dragoon
class.dragoon.desc: Flying rider who dives into the enemy for area damage.
class.dragoon.synergy: Dragoons take reduced damage at the start of combat and deal more dive damage.
class.engineer.name: Engineer
class.engineer.synergy: Engineer turrets are strengthened; all allies gain a little Attack Speed.
hero.P000.name: Leon Varke
hero.P000.title: Wandering Mercenary of the Grey Wolves
hero.P000.lore: A wandering mercenary from the free city of Bromel; he gathers the world's heroes to win back his beloved Elia.
hero.P000.skill_desc: Deals heavy physical damage to the current target. Guaranteed critical strike.
hero.H001.name: Lloyd Hartwin
hero.H001.title: Paladin Commander
hero.H001.lore: The last paladin commander keeping a dead king's oath; he sides with none of the three princes.
hero.H001.skill_desc: Shields all allies and raises their Armor while the shield holds.
hero.H002.name: Cedric Astel

hero.H002.lore: The second prince who tamed a wyvern, seeking outside help to end his brothers' war.
hero.H002.skill_desc: Dives into the densest enemy cluster, dealing area damage and briefly stunning.

nation.bromel.name: Bromel
nation.bromel.desc: The free city at the heart of the continent, home of the Grey Wolf mercenary guild, its arena and bounty board. Leon's hometown.
nation.astel.name: Astel
nation.astel.desc: The central knight kingdom. After King Alexander's sudden death, the princes Aldric, Cedric and Luan fight a civil war.
nation.astel.ruler: Vacant (civil war of the three princes)
nation.mir.name: Mir
nation.mir.desc: A vassal duchy of Astel. The duke declared neutrality, yet both armies march through his vineyards.
nation.harben.name: Harben
nation.harben.desc: The land of mercenary wars. The marchioness hires companies to hold her lands; battles erupt weekly.
nation.lumen.name: Lumen
nation.lumen.desc: The theocracy. The Pope declared the Ashwing 'divine judgment'; Saint Johanna and Paladin Gabriel left the church in protest.
nation.lies.name: Lies
nation.lies.desc: The league of western city-states where pirates and merchants coexist under a treaty with the merfolk. Lost half its fleet to the Ashwing.
nation.valheim.name: Valheim
nation.valheim.desc: The northern ice kingdom; a clan federation whose king is chosen by duel. Lost three clans to the Ashwing.
nation.karna.name: Karna
nation.karna.desc: The southern desert sultanate of merchant guilds, assassins and djinn-binders. The sultan made a secret deal with the Ashwing.
nation.torga.name: Torga
nation.torga.desc: The tribal federation of orcs, beastfolk, giants and goblins. Strength is law.
nation.kurgan.name: Kurgan
nation.kurgan.desc: The nomadic horse khanate of the eastern steppe, forever at war with Sairam and Torga.
nation.sairam.name: Sairam
nation.sairam.desc: The eastern empire where emperor and shogun share power. The shogun has made a pact with the Ashwing to depose the emperor.
nation.elowen.name: Elowen
nation.elowen.desc: The elven forest kingdom. The World Tree is withering, and the queen knows the Spire is the cause.
nation.grandur.name: Grandur
nation.grandur.desc: The dwarven mountain kingdom of forges, runes and steam engines, now excavating ruins of the ancient civilization.
nation.frost_isles.name: Frost Isles
nation.frost_isles.desc: Islands of the northern sea, home to whalers and frost witches; a buffer between Valheim and Lies.
nation.tiama.name: Tiama
nation.tiama.desc: The hidden undersea merfolk city. Bound to Lies by treaty, almost never open to outsiders. Felt the Spire tremble beneath the sea.
nation.tiama.ruler: King of the Deep Triton Var
nation.veil.name: Veil
nation.veil.desc: The fae realm beyond the mist in the depths of Elowen's forest. Those who enter lose track of time.
nation.zyros.name: Zyros
nation.zyros.desc: The lizardfolk theocracy of the southeastern jungle, full of giant reptiles and poison.
nation.nox.name: Nox
nation.nox.desc: The fog-locked necromancer kingdom on a peninsula, ruled by liches and vampires. Keeps the records of the blood-sealing rite.
nation.twilight.name: Twilight
nation.twilight.desc: A vampire count's domain on the border between Nox and the human world. Its gates open only at night.
nation.makab.name: Makab
nation.makab.desc: The southern volcanic land of lava spirits and obsidian golems, sustained by an ancient spirit pact.
nation.neos.name: Neos
nation.neos.desc: A hidden hi-tech civilization under a dome in the grey wasteland — survivors of the ancient civilization that caused the First Cataclysm. They know the Spire is a control device.
nation.celestia.name: Celestia
nation.celestia.desc: The high-magic academy on floating sky islands, guardians of the World Spire for a thousand years.
nation.drakestan.name: Drakestan
nation.drakestan.desc: The hidden nest of the Bluescale dragonkin, where unhatched eggs sleep.
nation.ashfell.name: Ashfell
nation.ashfell.desc: The Ashwing stronghold: burning mountains under an ash sky. Where Elia is held.

cutscene.CS-00.title: Prologue: Haron Burns
cutscene.CS-00.shot.0.visual: Night sky, red clouds. The border village of Haron burns. Wide shot.
cutscene.CS-00.shot.0.line.0: The continent of Arken. The seven kingdoms fought without end, and mercenaries were welcome everywhere.
cutscene.CS-00.shot.1.visual: A vast black wing crosses the moon; a woman's silhouette in its talons.
cutscene.CS-00.shot.1.line.0: That night a village became ash, and a woman was carried into the sky.
cutscene.CS-00.shot.2.visual: Leon runs through the flames, two swords drawn.
cutscene.CS-00.shot.3.visual: A single scale falls onto the ash. Close-up.
cutscene.CS-00.shot.3.line.0: The dragon said: 'The key is taken.' And the world's clock began to run.
cutscene.CS-01.title: Ash Dawn
cutscene.CS-01.shot.0.visual: Dawn over the ashes of Haron. Leon kneels, holding a black scale.
cutscene.CS-01.shot.0.line.1: A promise does not turn to ash. Leon tucked the scale away and rose.
cutscene.CS-02.title: The First Companion
cutscene.CS-02.shot.0.visual: Bromel arena. Torchlight and dust. Kasian sheathes his sword.
cutscene.CS-02.shot.0.line.0: I'm going to stop my father. I meant to go alone… but I suppose I don't have to.
cutscene.CS-02.shot.0.line.2: That's the most expensive contract there is.
cutscene.CS-03.title: The Walls of Camelin
cutscene.CS-03.shot.0.visual: On the walls of Astel's capital. Wyverns circle. Cedric and Leon.
cutscene.CS-03.shot.0.line.0: When Father died, 'advisors' attached themselves to all three of us. Advisors who smell of scales.
cutscene.CS-03.shot.0.line.2: And we were the buyers. I'm done buying.
cutscene.CS-04.title: The Banner of Haron
cutscene.CS-04.shot.0.visual: Burning palisades; Skar and Leon face off. Low angle.
cutscene.CS-04.shot.0.line.0: The end of the world opens only when the whole world comes.
cutscene.CS-04.shot.0.line.1: He laughed as he turned to ash.
cutscene.CS-04.shot.1.visual: The Grey Wolf banner rises over Haron's ashes.
cutscene.CS-04.shot.1.line.0: Leon's road now led across the whole continent.
cutscene.CS-05.title: The Saint's Resolve
cutscene.CS-05.shot.0.visual: The inquisition hall. Light breaks the chains. Johanna rises.
cutscene.CS-05.shot.0.line.0: Judgment belongs to heaven. Not to dragons.
cutscene.CS-06.title: Dawn at Porto Lies
cutscene.CS-06.shot.0.visual: Harbor panorama; Catalina's fleet opens fire. Wide.
cutscene.CS-06.shot.0.line.0: The sea does not forget a debt.
cutscene.CS-06.shot.0.line.1: The League of Lies raised its sails under Leon's banner.
cutscene.CS-07.title: The Queen's Blade
cutscene.CS-07.shot.0.visual: A snow-covered clan hall. Sigrun and Leon duel; blades clash.
cutscene.CS-07.shot.0.line.0: The throne of Valheim is bought by duel.
cutscene.CS-07.shot.0.line.1: The north follows the strong. That night the hearths of the north burned for Leon.
cutscene.CS-08.title: A Broken Contract
cutscene.CS-08.shot.0.visual: A desert fortress at night. Jafar drops a contract into the sand.
cutscene.CS-08.shot.0.line.0: If the world is ash, so is the money. You were right.
cutscene.CS-08.shot.0.line.1: For the first time, the desert assassins broke a contract.
cutscene.CS-09.title: Beneath the Blossoms
cutscene.CS-09.shot.0.visual: A road of falling cherry blossoms. Kagetora sits alone.
cutscene.CS-09.shot.0.line.1: The emperor's blade was drawn again — this time not for the emperor, but for a promise.
cutscene.CS-10.title: The Withering World Tree
cutscene.CS-10.shot.0.visual: The colossal World Tree sheds its leaves. Sylvana touches the bark.
cutscene.CS-10.shot.0.line.0: Guard it, or break it. No one yet knows a third way.
cutscene.CS-10.shot.0.line.1: But there were said to be three pieces. Sky, mist, and ash.
cutscene.CS-11.title: The Ancient Blueprint
cutscene.CS-11.shot.0.visual: A dwarven ruin wall bearing the Spire's sigil. Thordin's steel hand rests on it.
cutscene.CS-12.title: One Banner
cutscene.CS-12.shot.0.visual: Storm Strait. The ships, wyverns and riders of seven kingdoms gather under one banner. Epic wide.
cutscene.CS-12.shot.0.line.0: For the first time, the seven kingdoms fought under one banner.
cutscene.CS-12.shot.0.line.1: The Lord was wrong. Humans unite before they turn to ash.
cutscene.CS-13.title: The Road Beneath the Sea
cutscene.CS-13.shot.0.visual: Current tunnels lit by merfolk pearl-light. The party walks underwater.
cutscene.CS-13.shot.0.line.1: The Spire wept beneath the sea as well.
cutscene.CS-14.title: The Village Frozen in Time
cutscene.CS-14.shot.0.visual: The mist court; a village where clocks stopped. A frozen image of a woman (Isela) letting a drop of blood fall on an altar.
cutscene.CS-14.shot.0.line.0: The day the Spire first closed.
cutscene.CS-15.title: The Queen of Mist
cutscene.CS-15.shot.0.visual: The throne room of the Black Castle; Morgana on a throne of bone. Green phosphorescence.
cutscene.CS-15.shot.0.line.0: A dead world has no subjects to rule.
cutscene.CS-16.title: The Control Device
cutscene.CS-16.shot.0.visual: Inside the Neos dome; a hologram of the Spire's structure. Willow reaches toward it.
cutscene.CS-16.shot.0.line.0: Not a seal. A control device. Break it and it explodes; retune it and it flows.
cutscene.CS-17.title: The Cracked Spire
cutscene.CS-17.shot.0.visual: The sanctum. The great seal cracks and light leaks out. Orion falls to his knees.
cutscene.CS-17.shot.0.line.0: A thousand years of guarding — and it was the dragons' extinction I guarded.
cutscene.CS-17.shot.0.line.1: The third way was named: the Seal of Harmony. Now the dragons' power was needed.
cutscene.CS-18.title: Eggs That Do Not Hatch
cutscene.CS-18.shot.0.visual: The egg cavern. Giant eggs on warm stone. Kasian lays a hand on one.
cutscene.CS-18.shot.0.line.0: Not one has hatched in a thousand years.
cutscene.CS-18.shot.0.line.1: Let me see whether you are the one who will wake them.
cutscene.CS-19.title: The Memory on the Wall
cutscene.CS-19.shot.0.visual: Temple murals: a young black dragon and a human woman clasp hands → war → blood on an altar → a dragon left alone. Camera pans.
cutscene.CS-19.shot.0.line.0: That day my brother began to hate the world.
cutscene.CS-20.title: The Break
cutscene.CS-20.shot.0.visual: Sky Peak. The crimson dragon Ignis tears the black banner; the azure dragon Azelia spreads her wings.
cutscene.CS-20.shot.0.line.2: The eggs in the nest glimmered faintly. For the first time.
cutscene.CS-21.title: The Whole World
cutscene.CS-21.shot.0.visual: Outskirts of the Ash Throne. Banners of seven kingdoms, crests of the hidden nations, dragon wings. Epic wide.
cutscene.CS-21.shot.0.line.1: (voice) Come up. There is something I would ask.
cutscene.CS-22.title: The Altar
cutscene.CS-22.shot.0.visual: The altar before the crumbling Spire. Elia bound; Leon reaching out. Light leaks from the cracks.
cutscene.CS-23.title: The Black Dragon's Heart
cutscene.CS-23.shot.0.visual: The fallen black dragon lifts its great heart onto the altar. Kasian kneels at his father's side.
cutscene.CS-23.shot.0.line.0: Isela. I hear your voice. After a thousand years.
cutscene.CS-23.shot.0.line.1: Son. When the eggs hatch… watch for me.
cutscene.CS-24.title: Epilogue: The First Egg
cutscene.CS-24.shot.0.visual: The egg cavern of Drakestan. An egg cracks and a hatchling lifts its head. Leon, Elia, Kasian and Azelia watch.
cutscene.CS-24.shot.0.line.0: After a thousand years, the first dragon was born.
cutscene.CS-24.shot.1.visual: Haron, rebuilt. Leon hangs two swords on the wall. Ending credits.
cutscene.CS-24.shot.1.line.0: The wandering mercenary went home. The contract was done. The promise was kept.
